findings.highlight: No matter how I look at it, it just looks like a mound of trash... Well, a mountain of stuffed toys.
findings.evidenceJa: どう控えめに見ても、景品レベルのぬいぐるみの廃棄場—もとい、ぬいぐるみの山にしか見えないのだが。
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins to call the pile a dumping ground for prize-quality stuffed toys, then corrects himself to a mountain of plush toys.
findings.explanation: A dump of prize-grade plush toys becomes generic trash.

findings.highlight: "This Aztec stone mask's for you, Shirou. Your room's pretty sparse, so I thought it might liven things up a bit."
findings.evidenceJa: 「士郎にはね、このアステカの石仮面。士郎の部屋って殺風景でしょ？　これがあったら少しは温度があがるよ、きっと」
findings.governingReading: Taiga says the sun-mask will surely raise the temperature of Shirou’s stark room, setting up the warm/suspenseful description.
findings.explanation: Raising the room’s temperature becomes livening it up.

findings.highlight: "Fuji-nee...were these all from a crane game?"
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether the prizes came from a machine costing one hundred yen per try.

findings.highlight: "Hm, so there's also a Chinese dragon, a bat, a crab, a cow, a rhinoceros, a snake, and a soldier..."
findings.evidenceJa: 「えーっと、あとはチャイニーズドラゴンとコウモリとカニとウシとサイとヘビとトツゲキホヘイと……」
findings.governingReading: Taiga’s strange prize list includes a “charge/assault infantryman.”
findings.explanation: An assault infantryman becomes a generic soldier.

findings.highlight: I only took care of it for one month, but I would have liked to care for it till the end."
findings.evidenceJa: 預かっていたのは一ヶ月だけでしたが、出来ることなら最期まで共にいたかった」
findings.governingReading: Saber says she had the cub for only a month and, if possible, wanted to stay together with it until the end.
findings.explanation: Wanting to remain with the cub until the end becomes wanting to care for it.

findings.highlight: I'm not sure what kind of spell it cast on her.
findings.evidenceJa: それが、どんな魔法を持っていたのか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders what sort of magic the sight or object possessed as an unknowable scene rises in his mind.
findings.explanation: Unspecified magic becomes a spell cast on Saber.

findings.highlight: It has to just be some kind of dizzy spell...
findings.evidenceJa: ……目眩のような物なのだと、自分でも判っている。
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows himself that what he is experiencing is something like dizziness.
findings.explanation: Knowing the experience is like dizziness becomes uncertain diagnosis.

findings.highlight: But I'm not sure if this is just some fleeting vision.
findings.evidenceJa: それがその時だけの物なのか、俺には判らない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not know whether Saber’s age-appropriate, girlish self existed only in that past moment.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about Saber’s momentary girlhood becomes uncertainty about a fleeting vision.

findings.governingReading: After the vision disappears, Shirou’s chest remains disturbed and uneasy.
findings.explanation: An unsettled heart becomes a racing heart.

findings.highlight: The vision I glimpsed remains in my head like a scar that will never fade.
findings.evidenceJa: 垣間見た幻は、癒えない傷痕のように、脳裏に残った気がした。
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels the vision remains like a scar that has not healed.
findings.explanation: An unhealed scar becomes one that will never fade.
